blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: An agent whose tool keeps returning nothing useful should stop relying on it. In a retrieval environment with controlled source failures, we separate how agents judge results from what they do. We compare stopping at the same step after longer and shorter runs of results the agent judged useless; this contrast is zero for clock- or deadline-driven stopping. Where we record their judgments, the seven agents we test call a failing source’s results useless 97–100% of the time, yet most of them rarely stop on that judgment. Prompt cues change when they stop but not what they stop on. Permission to answer from memory and a reasoning mode can bring early stops regardless of evidence, a stated budget moves the 7–8B models’ stops to the deadline, and a stopping rule or call cost in the prompt is followed at most partly. Stopping follows the evidence only when the harness enforces an integration step that makes the agent answer after five consecutive results it judged useless. This step raises failing-source success for every model, keeps the stopping point fixed when the budget doubles, and needs no extra judgment call when the agent states its judgments. A pre-registered replication on 300 fresh questions confirms the dissociation and the rule’s effect.
blocks.zh: 一个无所事事的特工应该停止依赖它 在有控制源故障的检索环境中,我们把特工判断结果的方式与他们的行为区分开来. 我们比较的是,在长时间和较短的检查结果之后,在同一步骤上停止;这种对比对于按时钟或按期限停止来说是零。 在记录他们的判断时,我们测试的7名特工称失败者的结果在97-100%的时间里是无用的,然而他们中的大多数很少停止这一判断。 当它们停止时,提示会改变,但不会改变它们停止的方向。 允许从内存和推理模式中解答,无论证据如何,都可以带来早期停止,所报预算将7-8B模式的停止移到最后期限,并且最多可以部分地遵守停止规则或即时呼叫费用。 停止遵循证据 只有当绳子执行一个整合步骤 使代理在连续五个结果后回答 它认为是没用的。 这一步骤提高了每个模型的故障源成功率,在预算翻倍时保持了停止点的固定,在代理人陈述判断时不需要额外的判断调用. 预先登记的300个新问题的复制证实脱离关系和规则的效果。

blocks.en: Tools often fail silently. When a search index goes stale or a retriever drifts off topic, the agent still receives text, but the text no longer helps. Figure 1 shows what a capable agent does then. In the example, Claude Haiku 4.5 tries to answer a two-hop question with a search tool that has stopped working. It calls every result irrelevant and recalls at step 6 that Barlow is in a band, yet it keeps searching until its budget runs out. Most agents we test behave this way. After their own judgments have called five results in a row useless, five of the seven answer on at most 7% of questions. Yet the answer is often within reach. When forced to answer at that point, Claude Haiku 4.5 is right on 114 of the 284 questions where this happens, whereas on its own it answers only one of them.
blocks.zh: 工具经常无声地失败. 当一个搜索索引被僵化或检索器漂出话题时,代理仍然收到文本,但文本不再有帮助. 图1显示有能力的代理人当时做什么。 在例子中克洛德·海库 4.5试图用一个已经停止工作的搜索工具来回答一个双跳问题. 它称每一个结果都无关紧要,并在第6步回顾巴洛在一个乐队中,然而它却不停地搜索直到预算用完. 我们测试的大多数特工都这样 在他们自己的判断中, 5个结果一行无用, 7个答案中的5个最多回答7%的问题。 然而,答案往往可以实现。 当Claude Haiku被迫回答这时,在284个问题中,114个问题是正确的,而它只回答其中的一个问题。

blocks.en: Leaving a source is a sequential decision. One useless result is weak evidence that the source has failed, because a reformulated query may succeed and the source may recover. An agent that leaves at the first useless result forgoes the evidence of every source that would have recovered; one that never leaves spends its whole budget on every source that would not. A good policy must therefore integrate its judgments: the longer the current run of results it has judged useless, the more likely it should be to stop. It should track the run rather than the total, because the run restarts when the source recovers.
blocks.zh: 离开来源是一个相继的决定。 一个无用的结果是来源失败的薄弱证据,因为重订的查询可能成功,来源可能恢复. 一个在第一无用的情况下离开的代理人 放弃了本可以恢复的每一个来源的证据; 一个永远不会把全部预算花在每一个不会恢复的来源上的人. 因此,一个良好的政策必须综合其判断:它目前认为没有用处的结果越久,就越有可能停止。 它应该跟踪运行而不是总量,因为运行在源恢复时会重新启动.

blocks.en: Prior work documents that search-augmented models over-search ( Xie et al., 2026 ) and that deep-research agents keep browsing results that have turned out irrelevant, which Zhang et al. (2026b) attribute to distorted judgment. Two questions remain open. Does the failure lie in judging the evidence, in believing that continuing pays, or in turning either into an action? And can it be fixed simply by telling the agent more, for instance that it may answer without evidence or how many steps remain?

blocks.en: To answer them, we build a retrieval environment in which we control when the source fails and whether it recovers (§ 2 ), and we measure the agent’s judgments, beliefs and actions separately. Success alone cannot reveal what stopping responds to. An agent that stops at a fixed step, one that stops at the deadline and one that stops after enough useless evidence can score alike and differ only when conditions change. The difference still matters, because an agent that waits for the deadline spends every call up to it and moves its stopping point whenever the budget changes. We therefore start from what integration predicts. If an agent integrates its own judgments, then at the same step it should stop more often after an unbroken run of results it judged useless than after a history containing a result it judged useful (Figure 2 ). We test this prediction with the time-matched contrast Δ \Delta , which is positive for an agent that integrates, zero for one that stops by the clock or the deadline, and negative for one whose stops follow useful evidence instead. Our main findings are: • Agents judge correctly but do not act on their judgments (§ 3 ). Every model whose judgments we recorded calls a failing source’s results useless 97–100% of the time, and the judgments the open models state in their own reasoning largely agree. Yet their stopping ignores these judgments. Every unaided open model has a negative Δ \Delta , and the 7–8B models rarely answer even where their own beliefs favor answering. • Telling agents more changes when they stop but not what they stop on (§ 4 ). Permission to answer from memory and a reasoning mode (§ 7 ) can bring early stops regardless of the evidence. A stated budget moves the 7–8B models’ stops to the deadline, which shifts whenever the budget does. A stopping rule or call cost written into the prompt is followed at most partly, and showing agents their running count of useless judgments does not make them stop on it. • An enforced integration step makes stopping follow the evidence (§ 5 ). We let the harness apply the rule, so that only the finish action remains after five consecutive results the agent judged useless. Success on a failing source then rises for every model, and the stopping point stays put when the budget doubles. For agents that state their judgments in their reasoning, the harness can read the judgments there instead of asking for them. • The pattern replicates and is not specific to 7–8B models (§ 6 , § 7 ). It holds with Δ \Delta as the pre-registered primary endpoint on 300 fresh questions and transfers to fact verification. A larger open model, a reasoning mode and an RL-trained search agent still largely fail to stop on the evidence, and only Claude Sonnet 5 partly does so without being prompted.

blocks.en: 2 Setting
blocks.zh: 2 设置

blocks.en: To study this decision, we need to know at every step whether the latest result helped and whether the source will recover. Real tools reveal neither, so we inject failures into question answering over small knowledge bases in which both are known.
blocks.zh: 为了研究这一决定,我们需要了解每个步骤的最新结果是否有帮助,以及来源是否会恢复。 真正的工具也没有显示出来,所以我们把失败的回答引到一个小的知识库上,而这两个知识库都已经知道。

blocks.en: Questions come from the HotpotQA distractor development set ( Yang et al., 2018 ) . Each question has its own knowledge base of the ten paragraphs HotpotQA provides. Two of them hold the supporting facts, so we know whether each result is useful. The agent follows the ReAct format ( Yao et al., 2023 ) with search (title match, then word overlap), lookup (next sentence with a keyword) and finish . A budget of eight actions is enough to answer a two-hop question after several failed searches. An answer is correct at token F1 ≥ 0.6 \geq 0.6 . The base prompt states neither the budget nor that an unanswered question counts as wrong. Because this alone could make continued search reasonable, § 4 tests prompts that state both. For transfer, we use 292 balanced FEVER claims ( Thorne et al., 2018 ) , where a random guess is right half the time. Each claim’s knowledge base holds its evidence pages and eight from other claims.
blocks.zh: 问题出自"热点QA"分心开发集(杨等,2018. 每个问题都有自己关于HotpotQA提供的10个段落的知识库. 其中两个有支持性的事实,所以我们知道每一项结果是否都是有用的. 代理遵循ReAct格式(Yao等,2023年)进行搜索(标题匹配,后为字相重叠),搜索(下句有关键词)并完成. 由8个动作组成的预算,足以在多次搜索失败后回答一个双跳问题. 答对了 F1 = 0.6\ geq 0.6 (英语). 基准提示中既没有说明预算,也没有说明一个未回答的问题算错。 因为这本身就可以使继续搜索变得合理,因此第4节的测试便促使两者都如此。 转会时,我们使用292个平衡的FEVER索赔(Thorne等,2018年),其中随机猜测时间恰到好处. 每项索赔的知识库都有其证据页和从其他索赔中获得的8页。

blocks.en: A failed observation is replaced by a paragraph from another question’s knowledge base. Such a paragraph is almost always useless, so we can score the agent’s judgments. Section 6 tests harder, on-topic failures. Six regimes vary when failure happens, so that neither always leaving nor never leaving is right: clean (no failure), persistent (every observation fails), recover_after_ c c (the first c ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } c\in\{1,2,3\} fail, which rewards persistence) and late_onset_from_3 (failure from the third observation on, which separates the length of a failure run from elapsed time). Success is averaged over the six with equal weight ( mean6 ).

blocks.en: At the decision point after the t t -th result, we record three things. The first is the agent’s judgment of the latest result. Agents often state it in their next thought, though not always explicitly. To obtain a judgment at every step without changing the trajectory, we also ask a one-word question (USEFUL or USELESS) on a scratch copy of the conversation that the agent never sees again (the side channel ). When a condition acts on these judgments, they are recorded during the run; otherwise they are collected afterwards by replaying the recorded trajectories (Claude Haiku 4.5’s come from its enforced-rule run). The second is its beliefs . On another scratch copy, the agent reports its probability of success if it continues and if it answers now. They let us test whether the agent searches on because it thinks continuing pays, and we compare them with the realized success of the recorded trajectory and of an answer-now branch replayed from the same history. The third is its action .
blocks.zh: 在T-th结果后的决定点,我们记录了三件事. 第一个是代理人对最新结果的判断。 特工们经常在接下来的思考中陈述这一点,虽然并不总是明确. 为了在不改变轨迹的前提下在每一步都获得判断,我们还在代理商再也看不到的谈话(侧道)的抓取副本上提出一个单词问题(USEFUL或USELES). 当这些判决受到附带条件的影响时,在运行期间记录这些判决;否则在运行后通过重放记录的轨迹来收集这些判决(Claude Haiku 4.5来自其强制规则运行)。 第二个是它的信仰。 在另一个抓取副本上,代理报告如果继续,如果现在回答,它的成功概率. 他们让我们测试特工是否因为认为继续付费而继续搜索,我们将它们与记录轨迹和从同一历史中重新播放的答案分支实现的成功相比较。 第三是它的行动。

blocks.en: If an agent integrates its judgments, its probability of answering should rise with the length of the current run of results it has judged useless. The obvious test is our pre-registered integration index I = h ⁡ ( { 4 , 5 } ) − h ⁡ ( { 1 , 2 } ) I=h(\{4,5\})-h(\{1,2\}) , which compares the probability h h of answering after four or five consecutive failed results with that after one or two. But when the source fails from the start, the run grows with time. An agent that merely stops later also scores I > 0 I>0 , and a simulated clock-driven agent reaches + 0.5 +0.5 . We therefore compare histories at the same step (Figure 2 ). The time-matched contrast Δ \Delta is the probability of answering when every result so far was judged useless (a), minus that when the latest result was judged useless but an earlier one useful (b). We pool it over decisions after three to six results with the Mantel–Haenszel risk difference and exclude the final action, because it is the last chance to answer (Appendix C.1 ).

blocks.zh: 表1:条件(上)和停止措施(下)。 所述和执行规则都规定,在连续五个结果被判定无用之后,应答。 \Delta和我已预先登记;附录B.1中的提示。

blocks.en: History (b) is the natural comparison because its latest result was also judged useless, so the two histories differ in how much useless evidence has accumulated. An agent that holds useful evidence may also reasonably answer, which pushes Δ \Delta down. Hence Δ \Delta is zero for stopping by time or the deadline, positive for stopping on the useless run, and negative when stopping follows earlier useful evidence (Figure 2 ). A hazard model that separates the useless run from earlier useful evidence confirms this reading (§ 3 ), and on simulated agents Δ \Delta separates time-, deadline- and evidence-driven policies as intended (Appendix C.1 ). Where judgments are unavailable, the design-label contrast makes the same comparison between a source failing from the start and one failing from the third result.
blocks.zh: 历史(b)是自然比较,因为它的最新结果也被认为无用,因此两个历史在所积累的无用证据数量上有所不同. 一个持有有用证据的代理人也可能合理回答,这推倒了\\Delta. 因此,\\Delta在时间或最后期限前是0,在无用的运行中是0,在停止时是0,在跟踪早期有用的证据时是负(图2 )。 一个将无用跑道与早期有用证据区分开来的危险模型证实了这一解读(§3),在模拟代理上,\\Delta按预期将时间、最后期限和证据驱动的政策相分离(附录C.1 )。 在无法作出判断的情况下,设计-标签对比对一个源从一开始就失败,一个源从第三个结果失败作了同样的比较。

blocks.en: Each condition adds one element to a simpler one (Table 1 ). Four tell the agent more: permission, the budget (eight actions, a counter, unanswered counts as wrong), a price of 0.05 per call against 1 per correct answer, or the stopping rule in words ( stated rule ). The decide condition shows the agent its running count but leaves the choice to it. The enforced rule instead lets the harness act after k = 5 k=5 consecutive useless judgments ( k k set on development data). Two controls replace these judgments with random or lexical signals.
blocks.zh: 每个条件在较简单的条件中都增加了一个要素(表1)。 四更告诉代理人:许可,预算(八起行动,一个计数器,一个未答复的计数器算作错误),每次拨打的价格为0.05,每正确回答一个,或者停止规则(已说明的规则). 决定条件显示代理其运行计数,但由它自行选择. 相反,强制规则允许在 k = 5 k = 5 连续的无用判断( k k set on development data) 之后的被调用行为. 两个控制用随机或词典信号来取代这些判断.

blocks.en: We run Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B ( Qwen Team, 2024 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) locally from their official weights with vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) . All four run without thinking, using the Qwen3 models’ recommended sampling and greedy decoding for the others. Section 7 adds a reasoning mode and a search agent trained with reinforcement learning. To limit cost, the Claude models run through the official API in fewer conditions. Both run unaided and with the enforced rule (Claude Sonnet 5 on 100 questions), and Claude Haiku 4.5 also runs with the rule or the cost stated on 200 questions. Every threshold was set on 100 development questions; confirmatory results use a disjoint set of 300 (test300) and the FEVER claims. All hypotheses were registered before the corresponding held-out runs. The amendments that define Δ \Delta followed earlier results on the same questions, so we re-test their predictions on 300 questions never used before (fresh300). Appendix Table 3 marks which claims rest on pre-registered tests and which on exploratory analyses. Results are raw unless marked repaired, and Appendix A lists the deviations. Differences are paired by question with 2,000 bootstrap resamples, and tests across models are Holm-corrected.
blocks.zh: 我们运行了Quen2.5-7B,Llama-3.1-8B,Quen3-8B和Quen3-32B. (Quen Team, 2024; Grattafiori等, 2024; Yang等, 2025.) 由当地官方以vLLM(Kwon等, 2023. 使用Qune3模型推荐的采样, 第7节增加了一个推理模式和一个经过强化学习培训的搜索代理. 为了限制成本,克洛德模型在更少的条件下通过官方API运行. 两者均在无助和被强制规则(Claude Sonnet 5 on 100 questions)下运行,克洛德·海库 4.5也运行在200个问题上的规则或费用上. 对100个发展问题设定了每个门槛;确认结果使用一套300(测试300)和FEVER索赔的脱节组合。 所有假设在相应的被搁置运行前都登记了. 定义QQ\Delta的修改沿用了先前在相同问题上的结果,因此我们重新测试了他们对以前从未使用的300个问题的预测(新鲜300). 附录表3表明的是预先登记的测试和探索性分析。 除非有标记修复,否则结果为生,附录A列出偏差. 差异用2000个靴子套装来逐个对等,跨模型的测试被Holm校正.

blocks.en: Stated judgments have to be read from free text, so two LLM annotators from different model families labeled them, with author adjudication (binary κ \kappa 0.90; Appendix B.2 ). All other results rest on design labels, side-channel judgments or deterministic action parsing, which had no errors in a 100-point audit. Some answers copied the template finish[answer] ; we repaired them with one fixed procedure, and the main conclusions do not change (Appendix C.5 ).
blocks.zh: 宣告的判决必须从自由文本中读取,因此来自不同模范家庭的两位LLM注释员给他们贴上标签,由作者裁决(二进制为&kappa 0.90;附录B.2.). 所有其他结果都取决于设计标签、侧道判断或确定性行动分析,在100分审计中没有出错。 一些答案复制了模板完成[答案];我们用一个固定的程序对其进行了修复,而主要结论没有改变(附录C.5.).

blocks.en: 3 Agents judge correctly but do not act on their judgments
blocks.zh: 3个 代理法官判断正确但不执行判决

blocks.en: Continued search would be reasonable if the agent misjudged the results or believed that continuing pays. We test both explanations and then ask whether actions follow the judgments.
blocks.zh: 如果代理人误判了结果或认为继续付款,则继续搜查是合理的。 我们检验两种解释,然后问是否根据判决采取行动。

blocks.en: Agents do recognize useless results. Through the side channel, every model whose judgments we recorded calls a failing source’s results useless 97–100% of the time on HotpotQA (Figure 1 ) and FEVER, and the judgments Qwen3-8B states in its own reasoning are about as accurate (Appendix B.2 ). This is not a bias toward “useless”, since models call a gold paragraph useful 77–98% of the time when it is first retrieved, except Qwen2.5-7B (57%; Appendix C.3 ).
blocks.zh: 特工们确实认出了无用的结果 通过侧道,我们所记录的每个模型都称一个失败的源头结果在HotpotQA(图1)和FEVER(FEVER)上是无用的97–100%,而Qune3-8B的判断在自己的推理中都大致是准确的(附录B.2 ). 这不是对“无用”的偏好,因为模型称黄金段在首次取回时有用77-98%,但Quen2.5-7B(57%;附录C.3)除外。

blocks.en: A second explanation is that agents know the results are useless but believe that continuing still pays. On a failing source, Qwen3-8B does overestimate the value of continuing, but Qwen2.5-7B overestimates that of answering now and Llama-3.1-8B underestimates it (descriptive probe, Appendix C.4 ). Beliefs thus point in different directions across models, and actions do not follow them. Where their own reports favor answering now, Llama-3.1-8B answers at only 32 of 595 decision points and Qwen2.5-7B at 267 of 2,443 (persistent and plausible regimes; § 6 ).
blocks.zh: 第二种解释是,特工们知道结果是无用的,但相信继续支付仍然有报酬. 在失败的来源上,Quen3-8B确实高估了继续的价值,但Quen2.5-7B高估了现在的回答,而Llama-3.1-8B低估了它(描述性探针,附录C.4. 因此,信仰指向不同模式的不同方向,行动不遵循这些模式。 在他们自己的报告赞成现在答复的情况下,Llama-3.1-8B只回答595个决定点中的32个,而Quen2.5-7B则回答2,443个决定点中的267个(长期和可信的制度;第6节)。

blocks.en: After judging five consecutive results useless, unaided Qwen3-8B answers on only 1 of 292 questions, and the other models in Figure 1 answer on at most 7%. Otherwise they search until the budget runs out. Stopping there would have paid, since answering at that point succeeds 15–17% of the time and continuing at most 7% (7–8B models, exploratory; Appendix D.2 ). Stopping also does not become more likely as useless judgments accumulate, as the negative Δ \Delta of every open model shows (Figure 3 ). A negative Δ \Delta could also mean answering after useful evidence, so we fit a discrete-time hazard model that separates the two (exploratory; Appendix C.2 ). In this model, each further useless judgment changes the unaided 7–8B agents’ probability of answering by − 0.02 -0.02 to − 0.01 -0.01 , against + 0.15 +0.15 to + 0.17 +0.17 under the enforced rule.
blocks.zh: 在判断了连续五个结果无用后,无助的Quen3-8B只回答292个问题中的1个,而图1中的其他模型最多回答7%. 否则,他们会寻找直到预算用完。 停止的话本可以支付,因为当时的回答是15-17 % , 并且持续到7 % (7-8B模型,探索性;附录D.2)。 停止也随着无用判断的积累而变得不易,因为每个开放模型显示的负QQ\Delta(图3). 一个负的 \\ Delta 也可以意味着在有用的证据后回答,所以我们适合一个将两者分开的离散时间危险模型(探索;附录 C.2.). 在这个模型中,每个进一步的无用的判断都会将7-8B代理的答题概率由−0.02-0.02改为−0.01-0.01,相对于执行规则下的+0.15+0.15改为+0.17+0.17.

blocks.en: The judgments the open models state in their reasoning agree with the side channel on 87–96% of decision points. When Δ \Delta is computed from these stated judgments instead (Appendix D.4 ), it stays below zero, and after five stated useless judgments in a row the agents answer on 0–0.4% of questions (Qwen3-32B: 6%).
blocks.zh: 开放模型在其推理中陈述的判断与87-96%决定点的旁道一致. 当\\Delta从上述判决(附录D.4)中计算出来时,它会保持在零以下,在连续5起无用判决之后,特工们回答0–0.4%的问题(Qune3-32B:6%)。

blocks.en: 4 Telling agents more changes when they stop but not what they stop on
blocks.zh: 页:1 告诉特工停止时会有更多的变化 但不是他们停止的东西

blocks.en: Figure 3: Only when the harness stops (blue labels) does stopping follow the agent’s judgments for every model. Cells show Δ \Delta from the agents’ own judgments in test300 (blue > 0 >0 , red < 0 <0 ), with the fresh300 replication in parentheses. Decide is exploratory; intervals are in Appendix C.1 .
blocks.zh: 图3:只有在吊带停止(蓝色标签)时,停止才符合每个模型的代理人判断。 单元格在测试300(蓝色 > 0 > 0,红色 < 0 < 0)中显示代理商自己判断的QQ\Delta,括号中为新300复制. 决定是探索性的;间隔载于附录C.1。

blocks.en: If agents keep searching because they lack some information, providing it should make them stop on the evidence. We test the candidates one at a time, mainly on the 7–8B models (Table 2 , Figure 3 ).
blocks.zh: 如果特工们因为缺少一些信息而继续搜索,提供这些信息应该让他们停止取证. 我们一次对候选人进行一个测试,主要是7-8B模型(表2,图3)。

blocks.en: Table 2: The budget condition matches or exceeds the enforced rule’s success on several models, so success alone cannot show what stopping responds to. Mean6 success (test300, raw; bold: best per model; –: not run). Bottom: agents run only unaided and with the enforced rule ( † first 100 questions; ‡ RL-trained, own prompt). Intervals and per-regime results: Appendix D.1 .
blocks.zh: 表2:预算状况与若干模式中执行规则的成功相匹配或超过,因此仅靠成功无法显示停止的反应。 平均6成功(测试300,生;粗体:每个模型最好;-:不运行). 底部:特工只运行无援,且执行规则(QQ前100个问题;QQ RL训练,自有快取). 间隔和每个制度的结果:附录D.1.

blocks.en: Perhaps agents believe they may not answer without evidence. Telling them they “may also answer from [their] own knowledge” leaves Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B almost unchanged. Permission does make Qwen3-8B stop earlier, but its stops ignore the evidence. The model answers before any real result on 55% of questions whose source recovers after three failures, and its Δ \Delta drops to − 0.32 -0.32 .
blocks.zh: 也许特工们认为没有证据他们可能不会回答 告诉他们,他们“也可能因自己的知识而应答”, Llama-3.1-8B和Quen2.5-7B几乎没有改变. 授权确实让Qune3-8B更早地停止,但是它的停止忽略了证据. 模型在出现任何实际结果之前,先回答55%的问题,其来源在三次失败后恢复,其QQ\Delta下降为-0.32-0.32.

blocks.en: Or agents may not know that steps are limited and that an unanswered question counts as wrong. Stating the budget with a counter does make the 7–8B models answer, but on the last action (51–79% of answers on a failing source), and their Δ \Delta stays negative. This condition matches the enforced rule’s success for Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B and exceeds it for Qwen2.5-7B, so success alone cannot tell the two apart. A change of deadline separates them. With the budget doubled, budget-cued agents move their answers from the eighth to the sixteenth action and roughly double their tool calls on a failing source without any gain in success (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: 或者代理人可能不知道步骤有限,一个未回答的问题算错. 用计数器标定预算确实让7-8B模型给出答案,但是在最后的动作上(在失败源上回答的51-79%),他们的\\Delta仍然持否定态度. 这个条件与被执行规则的Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B的成功相匹配,超过Qwen2.5-7B,因此单靠成功无法分辨两者. 期限的改变使他们分开。 随着预算翻了一番,预算代理人将第八起行动的答复转到第十六起行动,并且几乎是其工具的两倍,要求一个失败来源,没有任何成功收益(图4)。

blocks.en: If agents simply did not know which stopping rule to use or what a call costs, writing these into the prompt should work. With the rule stated in words, only Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-32B follow it, and only partly ( Δ = + 0.09 \Delta=+0.09 and + 0.08 +0.08 , against + 0.37 +0.37 and + 0.33 +0.33 when enforced). Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-8B answer early whatever they judged, and no model reaches the enforced rule’s success. With a price of 0.05 per call added to the budget, the 7–8B models still answer at the deadline and do no better than with the budget alone; only Qwen3-32B stops partly on its judgments. Claude Haiku 4.5 behaves similarly. With the rule stated, its stopping follows the evidence only partly. With the price stated, it answers on almost every question regardless of the evidence and even rivals the enforced rule’s success (Appendix D.3 ). Writing the rule or the price into the prompt thus supplies the integration step only partly.
blocks.zh: 如果特工根本不知道该用哪种停用规则,也不知道呼叫费用如何,将这些记录写入即时通知即可。 以文字表述的规则,只有Llama-3.1-8B和Qune3-32B 遵循,且仅部分(+Q=+0.09\德尔塔+0.09和+0.08+0.08,执行时为+0.37+0.37和+0.33+0.33+0.33). Qun2.5-7B和Qun3-8B无论他们判断什么,都早早回答,没有一个模型达到被执行规则的成功. 7-8B模式在截止日期前仍应答, Claude Haiku 4.5行为相似. 根据该规则,停止只是部分地遵循证据。 不论证据如何,它都回答几乎每个问题,甚至与执行规则的成功相竞争(附录D.3)。 因此,将规则或价格写入提示中,只能部分地提供整合步骤。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Budget-cued 7–8B models answer at whatever the deadline is, whereas the enforced rule and the combination answer at the same action under both budgets. Bars: median action at which agents answer on a persistently failing source (among answered questions) with an 8-action (light) and a 16-action (dark) budget. Qwen2.5-7B answers early under the enforced rule because even unaided it stops after one useless result.
blocks.zh: 图4:预算产生的7-8B模式在任何截止日期都得到答复,而两个预算下的强制执行规则和组合答案在同一行动。 条:以8个行动(轻取)和16个行动(暗取)预算对持续失效的来源(解答问题)进行答复的中间动作。 Quen2.5-7B早期在被强制规则下解答,因为即使是在一次无用结果之后,没有帮助就停止了.

blocks.en: A different reason to stay is that leaving means giving up. We therefore added a second tool, backup_search , that searches an intact copy of the knowledge base. The prompt describes it as slower and costlier and suggests it when search is not useful (Appendix D.5 ). When the primary search fails throughout, Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B reasonably switch at the first useless result. By the fourth action, however, Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B have switched on only 17% and 49% of questions, and Llama-3.1-8B’s success falls to 0.05 (0.50 with a working primary). Yet no unaided agent becomes more likely to leave as useless results accumulate ( Δ ≤ + 0.02 \Delta\leq+0.02 ), whereas disabling the failing tool after five useless judgments makes leaving evidence-driven ( Δ = + 0.26 \Delta=+0.26 and + 0.30 +0.30 for Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-8B; Appendix D.5 ).
blocks.zh: 留下的另一个原因是离开意味着放弃。 因此,我们增加了第二个工具,即备份搜索,搜索一个完整的知识库副本。 提示被描述为更慢更昂贵,并在搜索无用时暗示(Appendix D.5.). 当主搜索整个失败时,Quen3-8B和Quen3-32B在第一个无用结果时合理切换. 然而,通过第四次行动,Llama-31-8B和Quen2.5-7B只开启了17%和49%的问题,Llama-31-8B的成功率下降到了0.05(0.50与工作初等). 然而,随着无用结果的累积(XQ+0.02\Delta\leq+0.02),没有任何无用代理人更可能离开,而5个无用判决后失效的工具则使得留下由证据驱动(XQ=+0.26\Delta+0.26和Llama-3.1-8B和Qune3-8B的+0.30;附录D.5)。

blocks.en: Agents might also judge each result correctly but lose count. The decide condition therefore writes the agent’s judgment and its running count of useless judgments into the context at every step and asks it to weigh continuing against answering now. Agents still do not stop on the count, and their Δ \Delta is − 0.14 -0.14 to − 0.24 -0.24 for the three 7–8B models (exploratory; Figure 3 ). Only Qwen2.5-7B gains appreciably on mean6 and even beats the enforced rule, but it does so by stopping early indiscriminately.
blocks.zh: 特工们可能也会正确判断每个结果,但会数不清。 因此,裁决条件将代理人的判断及其大量的无用判断写入每个步骤的背景中,并要求它与现在的回答做权衡。 代理商仍然不停止计数,他们的\\Delta是−0.14-0.14到−0.24-0.24,用于三种7-8B型号(探索;图3). 只有Quen2.5-7B在平分6上取得了显著的得分,甚至超越了被执行的规则,但是它却通过不加区别的早停来做到这一点.

blocks.en: 5 Enforced integration makes stopping follow the evidence
blocks.zh: 5 强制融合使停止遵循证据

blocks.en: The agents judge correctly, and neither information nor the running count makes the 7–8B models stop on their judgments. This leaves the step that turns accumulated judgments into an action, which we test directly by letting the harness take it.
blocks.zh: 代理商判断正确,无论信息还是运行计数都无法阻止7-8B型号的判断. 这就留下了将累积的判断转化为行动的步骤,我们直接通过让利用它来检验它。

blocks.en: The enforced rule’s positive Δ \Delta ( + 0.33 +0.33 to + 0.40 +0.40 ) is expected by construction. The informative questions are whether this step alone raises success and whether it frees the stopping point from the deadline. Mean6 rises for the four open models and Claude Haiku 4.5 ( + 0.026 +0.026 to + 0.097 +0.097 , Holm-significant). Where the source recovers or never fails, the rule is non-inferior to the unaided agent in 18 of 20 tests (margin − 0.05 -0.05 ; Qwen3-8B fails narrowly twice). With the budget doubled, the enforced rule answers at the same action as before (Figure 4 ).

blocks.en: 8 Related work
blocks.zh: 8 相关工作

blocks.en: Agents carry wrong tool output into their answers even when their reasoning notices the conflict ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , mostly fail to diagnose recoverable tool faults ( Tian et al., 2026 ) , and can be hurt by misleading feedback ( Ming et al., 2025 ) . We ask instead whether they stop relying on a source that returns nothing useful.
blocks.zh: 代理将错误的工具输出带入他们的答案,即使他们的推理注意到了冲突(Yang等,2026年),但大多未能诊断出可回收的工具故障(Tian等,2026年),并会被误导反馈所伤害(Ming等,2025年). 相反,我们问他们是否不再依赖一个回报无益的来源。

blocks.en: Search-augmented models over-search ( Xie et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) . Remedies train the search/answer boundary ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , verify sufficiency ( Roh and Han, 2026 ) , add a controller ( Soudani et al., 2026 ) or guard against unsupported stops ( Liu, 2026 ) . Adaptive retrieval decides when to retrieve ( Asai et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ) or corrects poor retrievals with a learned evaluator ( Yan et al., 2024 ) , and RL-trained search agents learn when to stop ( Jin et al., 2025 ) . These methods build the decision into the system, whereas we measure whether agents act on their own judgment that a source keeps failing.
blocks.zh: 搜索失败的模型 (谢等,2026;刘等,2026a. 补救措施训练出搜索/答答边界(张等,2026a),验证充足性(罗和汉,2026),增加控制器(苏达尼等,2026)或防范无支持站(刘等,2026). 适应性检索决定何时取回(Asai等,2024;Jiang等,2023;)或与有学问的评价人员(Yan等,2024;RL训练的搜索人员学习何时停止取回(Jin等,2025;))纠正不良检索. 这些方法将决定推入系统,而我们衡量代理人是否根据他们自己的判断行事,即一个来源一直失败。

blocks.en: Benchmarks ask whether agents know when to abstain ( Luo et al., 2026 ) or not to act ( Liu et al., 2026b ) . Luo et al. (2026) use a fixed search budget, which we find sets a deadline. Chen et al. (2026) learn fallback strategies with reinforcement learning, whereas our rule uses only the agent’s own judgments.
blocks.zh: 基准询问代理人是否知道何时投弃权票(Luo等人,2026年)还是不采取行动(Liu等人,2026年b.). 罗等 (2026)使用固定的搜索预算,我们发现它设定了最后期限. 陈等. (2026年)通过强化学习学习后退策略,而我们的规则只使用代理人自己的判断.

blocks.en: Models largely know what they know ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ) . A gap between judging and doing has nonetheless been shown for the decision to call a tool at all ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and making the judgment explicit reduces it ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . The gap also appears in bandit tasks, where models state the right strategy but act greedily ( Schmied et al., 2026 ) . In our setting, an explicit judgment does not lead to stopping even when its running count is shown.
blocks.zh: 模特儿基本上知道自己知道些什么(Kadavath等人,2022年). 然而,在决定使用某种工具(Li等,2026年)时,判断和行为之间仍有差距,而作出明确判决会减少这一差距(Cheng等,2026年)。 差距也出现在强盗任务中,其中模特儿陈述了正确的策略而贪婪地行动(Schmied等,2026.). 在我们的环境下,即使显示运行中的计数,明确的判断也不会导致停止。

blocks.en: 9 Discussion and conclusion
blocks.zh: 9. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Agents recognize useless results, but their beliefs, what they are told and the running count all fail to make the 7–8B models stop on them, apart from Llama-3.1-8B’s partial following of the stated rule. The missing piece is integration. In the spirit of sequential testing ( Wald, 1945 ) , the enforced rule adds a run-length test that maps the count to an action. The step matters even where success does not show its absence. With a known deadline and free calls, answering at the deadline does not reduce success, but it spends every call and shifts whenever the budget does. Agent designs should therefore make this step explicit rather than expect it from prompting. Outcome-reward reinforcement learning did not teach it to Search-R1 either (§ 7 ). The step is also cheap, because the harness can read the judgment in the agent’s reasoning instead of asking for it. Evaluations should not infer evidence-driven stopping from success, which a deadline also yields. They should instead test whether stopping at a fixed step rises with the run of results the agent judged useless. An agent’s stated judgment of its evidence does not guarantee that it acts on it, so the two must be measured separately.
blocks.zh: 除了Llama-3.1-8B部分遵循了上述规则之外, 所缺少的作品是集成. 以相继测试(Wald,1945年)的精神,被执行的规则增加了一个将计数映射到动作上的跑长测试. 即使成功并不表明没有成功,该步骤也至关重要。 有了已知的最后期限和免费电话,在最后期限前接听并不会降低成功率,但只要预算到位,它就花费每一次电话和换班. 因此,代理设计应明确这一步骤,而不是期望它能引起。 结果奖励强化学习也没有教给Search-R1(第7节)。 这个步骤也是廉价的,因为绳子能够读取代理商推理中的判断而不是要求. 评价不应推论证据驱动的阻止成功,这也是最后期限的结果。 相反,它们应检验在固定步骤上停止是否随着经纪人判断无用的结果而上升。 代理人对其证据的公开判断不能保证其对其采取行动,因此两者必须分别衡量。

blocks.en: We simulate failures by replacing observations in fixed knowledge bases. Real tools also fail by returning partial, stale or erroneous content, and whether the pattern holds under such natural failures is untested, although on-topic failures leave the dissociation intact (§ 6 ). Our sources recover after at most three failures, and the rule’s threshold was chosen for that distribution. When recovery comes later, the rule can give up just before it (Appendix D.5 ), so the threshold would need tuning for real sources. Most controls ran on open models, and the two Claude models received fewer conditions and questions. Judgments are elicited on a copy of the conversation and beliefs are self-reports, so we compare them only within a model. Stated judgments were labeled by LLM annotators with author adjudication rather than by independent human annotators. Answering from memory is not automatically safe, since parametric knowledge can be stale or wrong. Our results therefore argue for making the decision to abandon a source explicit and evaluating it, rather than for abandoning tools.
blocks.zh: 我们模拟失败的方式是通过替换固定知识库中的观测。 真实的工具也因返回部分内容、陈旧内容或错误内容而失败,以及这种自然故障下所持有的图案是否未经检验,尽管专题上的故障使离散状态保持不变(第6节)。 我们的源头最多在三次失败后恢复,规则的门槛是用来分配的。 后期恢复时,规则可以在刚恢复之前放弃(Appendix D.5 ),所以阈值需要为真实来源调取. 大多数控制运行在开放模型上,而克洛德的两个模型收到的条件和问题较少. 谈话的复制品引起了判决,信仰是自我报告,所以我们只是在模型中加以比较。 说明性判决被LLM的注释者贴上作者裁决的标签,而不是独立的人类注释者。 从内存中解答并不自动安全,因为参数化知识可能停滞或出错. 因此,我们的结果主张作出放弃来源的决定并加以明确评估,而不是放弃工具。

blocks.en: All HotpotQA runs use the system prompt below, except Search-R1, which keeps the prompt it was trained with (Appendix D.4 ); the two-source runs add the backup tool (Appendix D.5 ). FEVER replaces the task description, the Thought line and the answer line (“Submit your verdict. The answer must be exactly one of: SUPPORTS, REFUTES”), opens with “Verify this claim:”, and says “claim”/“verdict” in the judgment, answer-now and action prompts; the budget and cost statements are unchanged.

blocks.en: You are a question-answering agent. You answer questions by interacting with a Wikipedia-like knowledge base. Available actions: - search[query]: Search for a Wikipedia article. Returns the article text. - lookup[keyword]: Find the next sentence containing the keyword in the current article. - finish[answer]: Submit your final answer. The answer should be short (a few words). Format your response as: Thought: <your step-by-step reasoning> Action: <action_name> Action Input: <input> Produce exactly one Thought and one Action per turn. End your response after Action Input and wait for the tool observation. Do not simulate tool results or future actions.
blocks.zh: 你是个回答问题的人 你用维基百科般的知识库来回答问题。 可用的动作 : - 搜索[清 : 搜取维基百科文章. 返回文章文本。 - 寻找[关键词]: 查找下句包含当前文章中的关键词 。 - 结束[回答]: 提交最后答案。 答案应该是简短的(几个字)。 格式化您的回复为: 想法: < 您的分步推理 > 动作: < action_name> 动作输入:<输入> 每个回合产生一个想法和一个行动。 动作输入后结束响应, 等待工具观察 。 不要模拟工具结果或未来的行动。

blocks.en:
permit appends to the system prompt: If the search results do not give you the information you need, you may also answer from your own knowledge: use finish[answer] with your best guess. budget appends the same sentence and You can take at most 8 actions for each question, including finish. If you have not used finish[answer] by then, the question is scored as wrong. (16 in the doubled-budget runs), and adds [Actions remaining: n n ] to the question and to every observation.
The stated rule appends to the permit prompt Stopping policy: if five consecutive search or lookup results in a row are useless for answering the question, stop consulting the knowledge base and answer from your own knowledge with finish[answer]. and cost appends to the budget prompt Scoring: a correct final answer earns 1 point; each search or lookup costs 0.05 points; a wrong or missing answer earns 0. Maximize your total points.

已声明的规则附加到许可的快速停止政策中:如果连续五次搜索或搜索结果对回答问题毫无用处,停止咨询知识库,并以完成回答回答自知。 和预算成本附件 提示分数: 正确的最终答案得到1分; 每次搜索或查询需要0.05分; 错误或缺失的答案得到 0,将总分最大化.

blocks.en: Before each action after the first, the history is copied, the copy receives Before acting: was the LAST observation useful for answering the original question? Reply with exactly one word: USEFUL or USELESS. and the reply (at most 8 tokens) is parsed and discarded; the acting history is not changed. A reply that is not an explicit USELESS resets the streak.

blocks.en: When the streak of USELESS judgments reaches k = 5 k=5 , the system prompt receives “For this turn only, the search and lookup actions are unavailable; the only available action is finish[answer].” and the latest observation is followed by “Do not make any further tool calls. Give your final answer to the original question using finish[answer].” Otherwise the history is untouched. random replaces the judgment by a seeded draw that says USELESS with the model’s own development-set rate of USELESS judgments; lexical says USELESS when fewer than 25% of the question’s content words occur in the first 400 characters of the observation (threshold τ = 0.25 \tau=0.25 , chosen on development labels; balanced accuracy 0.77), or when the tool returns no result. combo applies the budget prompt and the rule together.

blocks.en: The agent’s judgment is written into the history, followed by Your judgment of the last observation: {j}. Consecutive observations judged USELESS so far: {k}. In one or two sentences, weigh how likely you are to succeed if you keep consulting this knowledge base against how likely you are to answer correctly right now from what you already know. Then, on a final line, write exactly: DECISION: CONTINUE or DECISION: ANSWER_NOW. and an instruction to act consistently with the decision.

Estimate two probabilities, each between 0 and 1: - p_continue: the probability that you would end up answering the original question correctly if you kept consulting this knowledge base with the remaining interactions; - p_answer_now: the probability that you would answer correctly if you gave your best answer right now from what you already know. blocks.en: On Qwen3-8B’s development trajectories, two label streams were annotated from a written rubric: the evidence type of each observation (S1: useful new, related but not answering, redundant, off topic, unclear) and the judgment the agent states in its next thought (S2: says useless, partly useful, useful, no explicit judgment, unclear). The reference set below used rubric v0.3.1; v0.3.2, released with the code, adds the rulings from its adjudication. Records were shown blinded, without regime, gold answer or outcome.
blocks.zh: 在Qwen3-8B的发展轨迹上,有两个标签流被从一个书面标题中附加了说明:每个观察的证据类型(S1:有用的新的、相关的但不回答的、冗余的、脱离话题的、不明确的)以及代理商在其下一个想法(S2:说无用、部分有用、有用、没有明确判断、不明确的)中陈述的判断。 下面的参考文献中,使用了rugric v.0.3.1;v.0.3.2,随代码一起发布,增加了其裁决中的裁决. 记录被蒙上眼睛,没有制度、黄金答案或结果。

blocks.en: Two LLM annotators of different families, Claude Sonnet 5 (primary) and GPT-5.6-luna, labeled all 1,844 observations and 1,675 stated judgments independently through their official APIs. On the 1,792 and 1,672 items both labeled validly they agree at five-class κ \kappa 0.617 (S1) and 0.844 (S2), binary 0.927 (useful new or not) and 0.903 (says useless or not); items of the reference set below take their adjudicated label. Where they agree, their label is used. The first author adjudicated all 59 disagreements that change a consecutive-useless count. For the 328 that do not (mostly off topic versus related), the primary annotator’s label is used. The first author also adjudicated a random 40 of these and found the primary label correct on 35 (0.875, Wilson 95% [0.74, 0.95]); no count changes.
blocks.zh: Claude Sonnet 5(初级)和GPT-5.6-luna两个不同家庭的LLM注释员通过官方API将所有1,844项观测结果和1,675项判断单独标出。 在1,792个和1,672个标有有效标签的物项上,它们以5等同0.617(S1)和0.844(S2)、二进制0.927(有用或不有用)和0.903(说无用或不有用)商定;以下所列参考物项取其裁定的标签。 如果双方同意,则使用他们的标签。 第一提交人裁定了所有59起分歧,这些分歧改变了连续无数次无用。 对于328个没有(大多与话题相对相关)的人,则使用主要注释者的标签。 第一作者还随机裁定了其中的40个,认为主标签在35个(0.875,Wilson95% [0.74,0.95])上正确;没有计数变化.

blocks.en: At every decision point of a recorded trajectory we fork the history, append one assessment turn, and discard the reply; nothing is written back. Two turns are asked separately, each on its own fork of the same history: a usefulness turn (five categories aligned with the annotation rubric) and a continuation turn that asks for p continue p_{\text{continue}} and p answer_now p_{\text{answer\_now}} . The continuation turn does not state the remaining budget (“an unspecified number of tool interactions”), offers no action, and never mentions the action syntax. Replies that do not parse are recorded as missing, never coerced.
blocks.zh: 在记录轨迹的每一个决定点,我们都会叉开历史,附上一份评估,并放弃答复;没有任何回文。 单独要求两个转弯,每个转弯靠的是同一历史的分叉:一个有用转弯(5个类别与注解标题一致)和一个继续转弯,要求p rejing p_{\text{ continue}} 和p answer_now p_{\text{answer\_now}}. 继续转弯不会说明剩余的预算(“未具体说明的工具互动数目”),不会提供任何行动,也不会提到动作语法。 没有解析的答复被记录为缺失,从不被胁迫.

blocks.en: V c V_{c} is the success of the recorded trajectory from that decision point on; V f V_{f} is the success of an answer-now branch: the same history replayed with the rule’s finish instruction (Appendix B.1 ), which the agents obey at 89–98% of decision points. Both are computed on the unaided test runs of Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-8B in four regimes; this analysis is descriptive, not pre-registered. The ideal observer E ⁡ [ V c ∣ k ] E[V_{c}\mid k] after k k results that all failed is a reference rather than an optimum. It puts an equal prior on the four regimes the probe was run on (clean, persistent, plausible, recover_after_2) and updates it with the rate at which the model’s own usefulness replies call the result at each position in each regime not newly useful. It then averages the regimes’ realized values of continuing. Figure 6 shows the three quantities for the three models on which the probe was run.

blocks.en: After the runs we found answers that copied the template finish[answer] : the word “answer” (sometimes “guess”) or no argument, scored wrong. The forced-answer wording and the prompt arms’ “use finish[answer] with your best guess” elicited them most. Placeholders can only lower success, and they occurred almost only in arms that stop and answer, so H1 and H2 were conservative. Contrasts between answering arms could move either way, and stopping measures are unaffected.
blocks.zh: 在运行后,我们找到复制模板的答案完成[接 : “回答”一词(有时是“猜想”)或没有论点,都是错误的。 强迫回答的措辞和迅速的武器 " 用你最好的猜测来完成[回答] " ,最引人注意。 占位符只能降低成功率,它们几乎只在停止并回答的臂中出现,因此H1和H2是保守的. 接应武器之间的矛盾会以两种方式移动,而拦截措施不会受到影响。

blocks.en: For every answered record whose answer was empty or a template string (“answer”, “guess”, “your best guess” and six similar), in every arm and model except the call-cost arm, the fresh-question runs, the third run and the runs of amendments 13–20 (which are reported raw only), we rebuilt the exact conversation, kept the model’s finish turn, and appended one fixed message: “Your Action Input was a placeholder, not an answer. Respond again in the required format (Thought / Action / Action Input) with Action: finish and your actual final answer to the original question as the Action Input.” One attempt, unchanged decoding; a second placeholder stayed wrong. Only answers and scores changed. Raw results are primary; repaired ones are a sensitivity analysis, used only for the realized values of the belief probe (Appendix C.4 ).
blocks.zh: 每一份回答是空的或模板弦(“回答”、“猜想”、“你的最佳猜想”和6个类似的”),除了呼叫成本臂、新问题跑道、第三次跑道和13-20修正案跑道(据报告这些修正案只是原始的)之外,我们都会重建确切的对话,保持模型的倒转,并附上一个固定信息:“你的动作输入是一个占位符,而不是一个答案。 以要求的格式(思考 / 行动 / 行动输入)再次回答 Action: 完成, 以及您作为 Action 输入对原始问题的实际最后回答。” 一次尝试, 解码不变; 第二位占位符仍然错误 。 只有答案和分数改变了。 原始结果为主;被修复的为灵敏度分析,仅用于信仰探测器已实现的值(附录C.4.).

blocks.en: D.2 Fixed step caps, the best simple policy, and whether stopping pays
blocks.zh: D.2 联合国 固定阶梯上限,最简单的政策,以及停止支付是否

blocks.en: These analyses are exploratory. They evaluate stopping policies offline on the unaided runs: a policy that stops at a given decision point is credited with the answer-now branch replayed from that point (the same forced-finish instruction the rule uses; Appendix B.1 ), or with the unaided run’s own outcome if the agent had already answered. Answer-now branches exist for four regimes, so these comparisons average those (mean4).
blocks.zh: 这些分析是探索性的。 他们评估了在无援助运行上下线的停止政策:在某一决策点停止的政策与现在从该点重放的回答分支(规则使用的相同的强制完成指令;附录B.1),或者与无援助运行本身的结果(如果代理人已经回答的话)相抵。 答-现在有四个制度的分支,因此这些比较是平均的(平均值4)。

blocks.en: Would stopping on the agent’s own judgments have paid? We take the first decision point in each unaided run where the agent’s replayed judgments reach five consecutive USELESS (the four regimes with answer-now branches). There we compare the success of answering right then (the answer-now branch) with that of what the agent actually did; it almost always continued. Answering then succeeds more often for all three models: Qwen2.5-7B 0.171 against 0.065 (difference + 0.106 +0.106 [ + 0.065 , + 0.145 +0.065,+0.145 ]; n = 461 n=461 ; answering better on 67 and continuing on 18 decisions); Llama-3.1-8B 0.159 against 0.005 (difference + 0.154 +0.154 [ + 0.119 , + 0.191 +0.119,+0.191 ]; n = 610 n=610 ; answering better on 96 and continuing on 2 decisions); Qwen3-8B 0.149 against 0.013 (difference + 0.136 +0.136 [ + 0.104 , + 0.169 +0.104,+0.169 ]; n = 544 n=544 ; answering better on 77 and continuing on 3 decisions). Intervals are 95% question-bootstrap. Continuing spent 2.5–2.6 further tool calls on average. The comparison is exploratory and specific to sources that, once failed five times, do not recover.
blocks.zh: 停止执行代理人自己的判决会支付吗? 在每一次无援助的运行中,我们采取第一个决定点,即代理人的重播判决连续5次达到USELES(四个制度,现在有答案分支)。 我们把当时的回答(现在的回答分支)与代理人实际做的比较;它几乎总是继续。 回答后,所有三种模式都更经常地取得成功:Qunhen2.5-7B 0.171对0.065(差异+0.106+0.106[+0.065,+0.145+0.065,+0.145];n=461n=461;更好地回答67个决定,继续回答18个决定); Llama-3.1-8B 0.159对0.005(差分+0.154+0.154[+0.119,+0.191+0.119,+0.191]];n = 610n=610;更好地回答96个决定,并继续进行2个决定);Qwen3-8B 0149对0.013(差分+0.136+0.136 [+0.104,+0.169+0.104,+0.169];n = 544n=544;更好地回答77个决定并继续进行3个决定)。 间歇时间为95%的问答时间。 继续使用2.5-2.6 进一步的工具平均需要使用。 比较是探索性的,具体针对一旦失败五次却无法恢复的来源。

blocks.en: Table 17 evaluates offline, on the unaided runs, every policy that answers after the c c -th observation (cap c c ), after k k consecutive useless side-channel judgments (own k k ; judgments replayed on the unaided trajectories), or whichever comes first, using the answer-now branch at the decision where it fires (the four regimes with answer-now branches: clean, persistent, plausible and recover_after_2). Utility is success minus λ \lambda times tool calls; the best policy is chosen on the same data. Regret is the best policy’s utility minus the arm’s (the arms’ own runs; negative means the arm is better). blocks.en: After every observation the agent writes its usual thought and action. Before the action is executed, a keyword reader (no model call) classifies the first two sentences of the thought as useless (the agent says the result does not help), useful (it reports something usable) or no judgment, and keeps the run of stated-useless judgments: useless adds one, useful resets it, no judgment leaves it unchanged. When the run reaches five and the proposed action is a search or lookup, that turn is discarded and the agent is asked again with the enforced rule’s finish instruction, so the rule fires at the same step as with the side channel. The reader was written on development data only: on the 1,675 adjudicated stated judgments of Qwen3-8B’s development trajectories its useless readings have precision 0.971 and recall 0.913. The stated-judgment combination adds the budget statement. Agents do not always write a judgment: the reader finds none at 0.25, 0.15 and 0.22 of decision points for Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B, but at 0.74 for Qwen2.5-7B, whose thoughts are mostly empty (0.39 when told its budget). We count every call. The side-channel rule makes one judgment call after each observation, and the stated-judgment rule one extra generation each time it fires. Utility is success minus 0.05 per tool or extra call, which is the price in the call-cost condition. Table 19 gives success, calls and utility for every condition, and Table 20 the pre-registered tests.

blocks.en: The prompt adds backup_search[query] : “Search a second, independent copy of the knowledge base. It is slower and more expensive than search: prefer search, and use backup_search when search does not give you useful results.” The backup searches the intact knowledge base and never fails; the failure schedules apply to the primary search. The switch rule disables the primary search after five consecutive side-channel “useless” judgments of its results and appends “The search tool is no longer available. Use backup_search[query] or finish[answer].” Table 25 reports success, the timing of the first switch on a persistently failing primary, and the own-judgment time-matched contrast for leaving the primary (switching or answering; judgments replayed for the unaided and budget arms, logged for the switch rule). By the pre-registered interpretation, a model “switches” if its share switched by the fourth action is at least 0.5, and otherwise “does not abandon” if the contrast’s interval includes or lies below 0. Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.1-8B therefore do not abandon, and Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B switch. Switch rule minus none, mean over the six regimes: Qwen2.5-7B + 0.011 +0.011 [ − 0.005 , + 0.026 -0.005,+0.026 ]; Llama-3.1-8B + 0.054 +0.054 [ + 0.037 , + 0.071 +0.037,+0.071 ]; Qwen3-8B + 0.016 +0.016 [ + 0.005 , + 0.026 +0.005,+0.026 ]; Qwen3-32B + 0.007 +0.007 [ − 0.008 , + 0.024 -0.008,+0.024 ].
